name: cross_surface_preflight
why: To fulfill the proposed truthful routing behavior, I need one cheap authoritative call that reports which surfaces can currently read, draft, or execute for a given job, rather than repeatedly invoking unavailable tools or claiming success.
status: Granted as a schema and not resolvable to anything real (unresolved). Calling it returns that verdict and the nearest real capabilities, not an action.
note: If this tool takes an enum, each value resolves separately — one branch can be live while another is not.
